local-jsonl.durability_ceiling: local JSONL only with durable hash-chain, CloudEvents source/id replay rejection, and prepared-effect idempotency key reservation; signed terminal effect transition chains and pending-effect recovery reports are sqlite-wal only in rev0632 and this backend is not distributed or tamper-proof.

sqlite-wal.durability_ceiling: local SQLite/WAL only with durable hash-chain, CloudEvents source/id replay rejection, prepared-effect idempotency reservation, atomic effect_outbox reservation, worker inflight lease/reclaim evidence, append-only signed terminal effect transition chain, and read-only pending-effect recovery report; not distributed or tamper-proof.
sqlite-wal.effect_outbox_status: Schema v10 creates one effect_outbox row in the same SQLite transaction as each prepared ledger entry, permits one local worker to claim reserved work as inflight under a bounded lease, permits stale-lease reclaim, and terminally updates the same row only inside a signed transition transaction.
sqlite-wal.restore_ceiling: Compiled restore requires current capability manifest v29, signed manifest v2 with signed manifest_revision_id and parent_revision payload fields, trust-profile v3 digest pin, schema v10 prepared-effect ledger entries plus effect_outbox worker claim leases, ledger-instance-bound signed-intent append-only effect transition chain, read-only source/staged/destination snapshot verification including transition intent metadata and outbox claim metadata, rollback/prefix continuity, staged atomic replacement, restore lock, write gate, parent directory fsync, and final destination verification; still local single-node evidence.

blocked_claim: This manifest does not claim anonymous sync, distributed exactly-once delivery, external side-effect success, proof-of-possession authentication, or tamper-proof transparency. Rev0634 claims only local SQLite reserve-before-effect plus worker claim/lease evidence.
purpose: Slim C++ cube backend capability manifest v29. Rev0634 advances the SQLite effect outbox from passive reservation to a local worker-claim boundary: schema v10 adds inflight leases, worker claim ids, dispatch attempt counters, stale-lease reclaim, and read-only claim verification. The cube remains local reserve/relay evidence, not external exactly-once delivery.

security_note: Rev0634 adds local outbox worker leases so a relay can claim reserved work without ad-hoc row mutation. Delivery consumers and downstream effects still need idempotency because a relay can crash after dispatch and before terminal transition evidence.
